description: LLM-powered sentiment analysis: ETL stages for pipeline integration and REST API endpoints for on-demand analysis and result querying.

stages.description: Analyzes the sentiment of a text field using an LLM. Adds sentiment_label (positive/negative/neutral) and sentiment_score (0.0–1.0) to each row.

arg_schema.name: text_field
arg_schema.description: Name of the field containing the text to analyze

arg_schema.name: save_result
arg_schema.description: If true, persists result to sentiment_results table

arg_schema.name: entity_type
arg_schema.description: Entity type label for DB storage (e.g. 'product', 'review')

stages.description: Filters rows by sentiment_label or minimum sentiment_score.

arg_schema.name: label
arg_schema.description: Keep only rows with this label (positive/negative/neutral). Empty = no label filter.

stages.description: Source stage: loads stored sentiment results from DB for a given entity type.

arg_schema.name: label
arg_schema.description: Filter by sentiment label. Empty = all.

stages.description: Sink stage: persists sentiment result to DB. Upserts by (org_id, entity_id, entity_type).
